profile.headline: Business Technology & Adoption | Sales Enablement & Training Strategy | MarTech  Change Management | AT&T | Salesforce Alumni | Digital Transformation
profile.summary:
Results-driven technology and enablement leader with 20+ years of experience spanning Salesforce ecosystem architecture, sales enablement, change management, curriculum development, and commercial training strategy. 

Proven track record designing and executing onboarding, training, and user adoption programs that measurably improve field performance and accelerate business outcomes. 

Deep expertise in Salesforce Sales, Service, Health, Experience, and NonProfit Clouds, including recognized leadership as Salesforce Practice Lead scaling digital transformation. 

Passionate about translating complex technical capabilities into practical learning experiences that empower teams and drive commercial excellence. 

Adept at partnering cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Commercial Operations, and executive leadership to align enablement strategy with organizational growth priorities.

positions.title: Director of Operations | Salesforce Administrator
positions.description:
Responsible for the fundamental processes and performance metrics associated with their daily business workflow efficiencies, vendor relationships, price matrices and streamlined interdepartmental communications.
 
Since her addition to the team, Smith has proven herself to be extremely valuable. Through collaboration with ​the team of marketing enthusiasts, including production managers, account executives, graphics and interactive artists, digital professionals and more, she works to develop scalable processes and data handling models as Force Marketing continues to achieve revenue and team growth.
positions.insights: Skills: Sales Processes · Stressful Situations · Microsoft PowerPoint

positions.title: Marketing Operations Manager | Salesforce Administrator
positions.description:
Manage daily operations, work flows, account management and retention of our internal marketing agency – supporting multiple lines of business for dealerships nationwide.
Prep annual budget, set monthly goals, reviewing monthly statements – using financial data to improve profitability, create cost savings and efficiencies.
Develop and implement annual marketing communications plans, KPIs, and strategies resulting in accelerated sales growth and profitability.
Direct and manage creation of B2B and B2C marketing collateral, brand guidelines, and best practices for sales teams, account management and support agencies.
Configure Salesforce CRM tools, dashboards and reports to publish and present standard metrics, including: marketing program responses, qualified opportunities and leads, closed pipeline sales, revenues, current account statuses and more. 
Manage Salesforce data integrity and hygiene with periodic system updates, upgrades, and ongoing administration.
Develop thorough market analysis, presentations, and budget plans as needed for national account groups.
Foster relationships with vendors and agents to champion industry-wide brand exposure.
Assist with coordinating seminars and exhibit displays for tradeshows and industry conventions.
Monitor client problem/crisis situations.
Organize recruitment and placement of required staff, establish organization structures, and evaluate team performance.

positions.title: Facilities Service Support | Fulfillment | Corrigo Systems Administrator
positions.description:
Corrigo systems database administrator. Managing multi-user platform portal creation to maintain data integrity with tracking and automated reporting – supporting various file formats.
Performed software training for field and office preventative maintenance and CAM property technicians – implementing best practices.
Setup automated system workflow tracking via work order process, property asset details, repair cost, invoicing, and critical issues.
Client Implementation and Training
Assisted with full property CAM management. Evaluated problem/crisis situations as needed; investigated for solutions.
Conducted property infrastructure assessment reviews and facility walk-throughs for complex sourcing projects.
Provide training to the staff members on the new procedures and systems implemented. 
Fostered strong client relationships while developing an understanding of business needs
Assessed and altered client needs by documenting sourcing opportunities, benefits, risks, and success factors of potential infrastructure supply programs.
Investigated client needs, regulations, and technology to provide input relating to the on-boarding of new customers.

positions.title: Marketing Production Coordinator | Systems & Runsheet Administrator
positions.description:
Designed and distributed monthly B2B campaign kits for marketing and public relations campaigns. 
Worked directly with clients for pre-sales, project management, customer support and technical delivery roles.
Ensured that projects are implemented on time and within scope and budget
Planned, scheduled, and coordinated production of print and broadcast media advertising.
Determined the procedures pertinent to ongoing process/workflow measures.
Ensured creative projects were initiated properly and distributed to graphic artists and freelancers.

positions.title: Exec. Administrative Assistant | Marketing Support Liaison
positions.description:
Prepared financial and statistical productivity reports to evaluate outpatient medical operations efficiencies.
Initiated Marketing Benchmark Programs, depositions, preceptorships and in-services, pursuing duplication of operational infrastructure.
Facilitated and Trained Staff on Daily Operations, Marketing Guidelines, Policies, and Procedures

positions.description: Budget - Finance Reporting.  Property Management.  Real Estate Admin.  Invoicing. Operations Management.  Project/Program Management. Policies and procedures.
